items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: I never got to know him.

ctx.x: Yeah, make a little money and they can play for a dance. That's all they do.

But I'll tell you what I'm doing though. I have a composition that I'd throw on the side. I'd throw that composition on the side because at that time I didn't think anything of it. But you see, T. K. Huerta called man, he had a brother by the name of Uris. A singer. He had some kind of a band. He used to go around, a little routine band. I never got to know him.
I'm sorry. I always... Well, he died too. Yes, I heard about him.
